architecture_proofs.name: persistent-reference prototype
architecture_proofs.verdict: PASS on the bar; hypothesis reframed from survival to repair

largest_gap: the abstention thresholds decide every result in rounds 003-004, and nobody has a principled basis for them.
notes: P0-C and P0-A PASS. Repair measured across rounds 003-004: 0 mis-repairs in 21 strategy-decisions, but conditional on unprincipled thresholds. P0-B, P0-D, P0-E remain unproven. No superiority claim.
wedge_note: Rounds 002-004: references rarely break; when they do, the best strategy (geometry + exclusion by surviving references) proposes a correct candidate about half the time and a wrong one never, and abstains the rest. A real but modest feature. Differentiation points at diagnosis (D-013).
rounds: round-003-repair: repair on hard geometry (PASS, repair constrained to human-confirmed)
round-004-provenance: provenance vs exclusion (PASS, exclusion adopted, provenance rejected as filter)
